summary: The trace reveals a distinct capability: constructing multi-sheet Excel workbooks from CSV/JSON inputs with cross-sheet formula references, control rows, and specific column layouts. This is fundamentally different from the existing excel-inventory-analysis skill (which focuses on gap analysis calculations). The agent made repeated errors overwriting data cells with summary formulas and referencing wrong worksheet variables. A new skill for Excel workbook construction with rollforward/reconciliation patterns will prevent these failures.
